spec: AUTOMATED POST-TRAINING.md (this file is the machine-readable part; the .md explains it)
change_rule: Only a deliberate, announced change bumps contract_version. Both sides refuse to run on a version they do not know. Whoever bumps it must tell the user, who then updates the other machine.

ownership.rule: Neither machine edits or deletes files the other one owns. Built datasets and training outputs stay local on the Mac, only finished policies are published.

task: pick up the white block and place it on the red area
state_units: lerobot_robot_piper normalization: joint1..joint6 in -100..100, gripper 0..100 = raw 0..68000 (clamped). Identical to datasets/piper_pick_place observation.state.

rollout_package.complete_when: READY exists. READY is written last, after the operator marked Success/Fail; its text is the outcome. Ignore any folder without READY.

files.episode.jsonl: one JSON row per 15 Hz control step, in order
files.wrist.mp4: mp4v video; decoded frame i (BGR from OpenCV, convert to RGB) is exactly the image the policy saw at row i

row_fields.k: control step index; a gap (k jumps by more than 1) means rows+frames were dropped together -> split the episode there
row_fields.state: 7 floats, joint_names order, measured at this step
row_fields.sent: 7 floats actually commanded (null in human segments)
row_fields.plan: 7 floats, the model's plan value for this step before clamps (null in human segments or when starved)
row_fields.cam_age_ms: age of the frame when used
row_fields.obs_step: k of the observation the current plan came from

episode_rules.action: action[t] = state[t+1], exactly like the teaching data; the last row of each episode is dropped
episode_rules.human_segments: always eligible (success or fail): each contiguous run of segment == human with >= 30 rows becomes one episode
episode_rules.policy_segments: eligible only when outcome == success AND interventions == 0: the whole run becomes one episode
episode_rules.never_use: policy segments of failed runs or of runs that needed an intervention

training.dataset: ALWAYS base dataset (idle starts trimmed) + all eligible rollout episodes. Never rollouts alone: lerobot-train with --policy.path recomputes normalization from the given dataset (lerobot_train.py:262-280).

publishing.current_file: policies/CURRENT.json  {"name", "since", "reason"}; the Dell portal preselects this checkpoint
publishing.promotion: candidate becomes CURRENT only after >= 10 labelled trials of it in deploy/runs/results.csv with a success rate >= CURRENT's on its most recent 10 trials
